subject: math
title: Place value to 10,000
canDo: I can say what each digit in a 4-digit number is worth and multiply or divide by 10 and 100.

subject: math
title: Compare and order numbers to 10,000
canDo: I can compare and order 4-digit numbers.

subject: math
title: Round to the nearest 10, 100 or 1,000
titleId: Membulatkan ke puluhan, ratusan, atau ribuan terdekat
canDo: I can round numbers and use rounding to estimate an answer.

subject: math
title: Negative numbers and temperature
canDo: I can read negative temperatures and count on and back across zero.

subject: math
title: Number sequences and rules
canDo: I can find the rule of a sequence and use it to find missing numbers.

subject: math
title: Mental addition and subtraction
canDo: I can add and subtract 3-digit and 4-digit numbers in my head with quick strategies.

subject: math
title: Written addition and subtraction to 10,000
canDo: I can add and subtract 4-digit numbers in columns and check with an estimate.

subject: math
title: Times tables up to 10 × 10
canDo: I can recall every times table up to 10 × 10 and use it to work out related facts.

subject: math
title: Factors and multiples
canDo: I can find factors and multiples of a number.

subject: math
title: Multiply by a 1-digit number
canDo: I can multiply 2-digit and 3-digit numbers by a 1-digit number.

subject: math
title: Divide by a 1-digit number
canDo: I can divide by a 1-digit number and decide what to do with a remainder.

subject: math
title: Tenths and hundredths
canDo: I can read, write and compare decimals with tenths and hundredths.

subject: math
title: Equivalent fractions and comparing
canDo: I can find equivalent fractions and compare fractions.

subject: math
title: Add and subtract fractions with the same denominator
titleId: Menjumlahkan dan mengurangkan pecahan berpenyebut sama
canDo: I can add and subtract fractions that have the same denominator.

subject: math
title: Fractions of amounts and measures
titleId: Pecahan dari suatu jumlah dan ukuran
canDo: I can find a fraction of a number, an amount of money or a measure.

subject: math
title: Money problems in rupiah
canDo: I can solve shopping problems with prices, totals and change in rupiah.

subject: math
title: Money with a decimal point
canDo: I can add and subtract amounts of money written in dollars and cents.

subject: math
title: 12-hour and 24-hour clocks
canDo: I can change times between the 12-hour clock and the 24-hour clock.

subject: math
title: Timetables and time intervals
canDo: I can read a timetable and work out how long a trip or an event takes.

subject: math
title: Convert units of length, mass and capacity
titleId: Mengubah satuan panjang, massa, dan kapasitas
canDo: I can change between mm, cm, m, km, g, kg, ml and l.

subject: math
title: Perimeter and area of rectangles
canDo: I can calculate the perimeter and area of rectangles and shapes made from rectangles.

subject: math
title: Acute, obtuse and right angles
canDo: I can sort angles into acute, right and obtuse and compare their sizes.

subject: math
title: 2D shapes: properties and symmetry
canDo: I can sort triangles and quadrilaterals by their properties and count lines of symmetry.

subject: math
title: 3D shapes and nets
canDo: I can describe 3D shapes and match them to their nets.

subject: math
title: Coordinates and translation
canDo: I can read and plot coordinates and move a point or shape by a translation.

subject: math
title: Tables, pictograms and bar charts
canDo: I can read and compare data in tables, pictograms and bar charts.

subject: math
title: Venn and Carroll diagrams
canDo: I can sort and read data in Venn and Carroll diagrams that use two rules.

subject: math
title: Likelihood and chance
canDo: I can describe chance with words like even chance and order outcomes by how likely they are.
